sessions.name: Week 1: 22 km, long run 10 km
sessions.description:
22 km over 3 runs: Tue easy 6 km, Thu easy 6 km with strides, Sun long 10 km.
Rides: Sat group ride (NP at or below 200 W).
Rest day: Mon 4 Jan.
Strength: A Wed evening, C Tue after the run.
If you track an injury score, log it every morning.

sessions.name: Rest day + recovery
sessions.description:
Rest day: no run, no ride, no leg strength.
10 min mobility and an early night.
This week's recovery: sauna after the Thursday run and the long run.

sessions.name: Easy 6 km + Strength C (upper)
sessions.description:
Easy, conversational. Then Strength C (upper body, about 20 min).

- 6km 69-86% LTHR

sessions.name: Strength A (evening)
sessions.description: Full legs, about 40 min: single-leg calf raises, bent-knee calf raises, split squats, single-leg RDLs.

sessions.name: Easy 6 km + strides
sessions.description:
Easy. Finish with 6x20 s strides on flat ground, walk back between. Sauna after.

- 6km 69-86% LTHR

sessions.name: Group ride
sessions.description: Aerobic: NP at or below 200 W. The long run is tomorrow, so if it isn't easy, a ride before the long run needs a logged exception.

sessions.name: Long run 10 km
sessions.description:
Easy the whole way, walk the climbs if needed to stay under the cap. Sauna after.

- 10km 69-86% LTHR

exceptions.ride_before_long_run: Example: an easy group ride before an easy 10 km long run in a base week
